annotations.text:
Matching the built app: iOS native vocabulary, inset-grouped cards, SF Pro, accent #2a78d6 (the validated blue already in TrendView).

The Today trace is synthetic sample data shaped like real wrist readings.

Strain is the HRV + resting-HR z-score from the README, centred at 50.

Bar values are illustrative — there is no logged-activity history yet to compute them from.
